# pvecli ct template

Convert one or more containers to templates.

```text
pvecli ct template [CTIDS] [OPTIONS]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `CTIDS` | CT ID(s) - single, comma-separated, or range (e.g., 100, 100,101, 100-105). |

## Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
| `-y`, `--yes` | Skip confirmation. |
